text: At the 65th minute near the center of the pitch, Redmond Rovers adjust their approach to chase the game. They press Ironvale Athletic more intensely, moving their defensive line higher up the field, around 30 metres from their own goal at the near end. Their play becomes more direct and vertical, aiming to quickly break through Ironvale's deep defensive block and create scoring chances despite lowering overall possession. This tactical change increases Redmond’s attacking presence and expected goals, pushing forward aggressively on all flanks[#1190].
